release.note: Publish copy budget fix (#101) released 2026-10-19 after the production incident where a 16-image Publish exceeded the Cloudflare 50-subrequest limit: promotion now uses one server-side Storage copy per image plus one listing to verify size/type, batched compensation, planned/result audit rows, and a pre-flight budget of 30 new images per Publish surfaced in the import dialog, the editor action bar and the colleague docs. Merge 94e9886 deployed as immutable 446c9338; immutable/apex/www bound smoke and the production admin gate (10 routes) passed. The 14 orphan public copies from the incident were deleted by Jay in the Supabase dashboard and read back as zero. Project 23 remains a complete draft awaiting the editor's retry.
